v15_data_contract_freeze.label_semantics: start-of-period archive-wide on current published bytes: labeled T carries the stock snapshot at T+5min and the taker flow window [T, T+5min); loader normalizes row identity to snapshot time

v15_data_contract_freeze.availability_semantics_binding: MEASURED_BOUND_LAG_3D: every V15 conditioning decision may only read metrics rows with metrics_date <= decision_date - 3 calendar days. Basis: max measured publication lag 67.47h across 4,911 evidenced-regime files; 3 days is the conservative ceiling under every measured regime, so the frozen design is invariant to the within-envelope uncertainty

stage_a_gates_frozen: V13/V14 set unchanged, applied ex ante: (1) after-cost anchor expectancy > 0; (2) position PF >= 1.10; (3) >= 2/3 folds positive; (4) largest fold-positive share <= 0.50; (5) MDD <= 0.20; (6) largest symbol positive-PnL share <= 0.70; (7) stress set positive with multipliers on booked PnL; (8) drop-one symbol and fold non-vacuous; (9) BTC buy-and-hold excess and BTC-beta context excess positive in >= 2/3 folds; (10) neighbour supports; (11) causal control does not reproduce under its preregistered rule; (12) reproduction ALL_MATCH; (13) zero unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL; positive raw PnL never overrides a failed concentration/context gate or a firing control
margin_to_fail_scaffolding: every gate report carries margin-to-fail = signed distance from the failure threshold (P-2); thin margins recorded as thin, never rounded in a survivor's favor

selection_rubric_frozen_before_proposals.ranking_rule_deterministic: within eligibility: prefer distinct primary axes across selected families (AXIS-1 OI level/structure, AXIS-2 crowding ratios, AXIS-3 taker flow); then prefer proposals whose causal control is most structurally independent of the anchor mechanism; then earlier hypothesis ID as tiebreak. No PnL, no outcome, no aesthetic language participates.
